hooks.text: 铺设沟槽引导怪物，再布置恐怖装置阻止其走到迷宫终点
hooks.excerpt: Lay down gutters and destructive terrors to obliterate Bella’s friends and their grotesque minions. Just don’t let them reach the end of your maze or Bella will get upset.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 路线选择同时决定奖励和敌种，可定向寻找沟槽、装置或纪念物
hooks.excerpt: Choose your path to pick specific rewards and which monstrosities to face. Decide whether you want to seek out gutters, terrors, or powerful mementos to upgrade your abilities.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 同一防线可做长蛇沟槽精确布塔，也可压缩成短程火力走廊
hooks.excerpt: Do you want to build a winding length of gutters with carefully placed terrors, or a short terror barrage gauntlet?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
